Affordability Complaint Strength Checker

Answer these questions about the loan and your situation at the time you borrowed. This tool gives you a plain-English read on how strong an affordability complaint under CONC 5.2A looks, and which specific failures to point to if you decide to complain.

1. What type of agreement is this?
2. At the time you took out this loan, what best described your income?
3. Did you have other loans or high-cost credit running at the same time?
4. How many times did you roll over, renew, or take a further top-up loan from this same lender?
5. Did you ever tell the lender you were struggling financially, for example asking for more time or mentioning money problems?
6. Did the lender ask for evidence of your income and outgoings (bank statements, payslips, etc) before agreeing the loan?
7. What did you mainly use this loan for?
8. Looking back, how did repaying this loan affect your finances that month?
9. What is the current status of this loan?
10. Roughly how long ago did you take out this loan?

Please answer every question so the assessment is accurate.
